name: jairf-data-arch
description: JAIRF data architecture roadmap (per 08_Data_Architecture_Notes.md). ScriptableObject + data tables first; no hard-coded values. Data types: SO_Item, SO_Equipment, SO_Skill, SO_Recipe, SO_BuilderPiece, SO_Quest, SO_NPC, SO_Enemy, SO_LootTable, SO_StatusEffect, SO_Class/SO_Progression. Organization by category, Addressables groups, runtime-mutable data kept separate. Agent guidelines: create SO + link assets, no magic numbers, composition over inheritance. Save/network: player, builder creations, world state schemas.

phases.name: 5. Save/network data schemas (player, creations, world state)
